notes: RULE 3 CHECK: the site is fully LIVE, not retired, parked or redirected. www.designpublic.com returns 200 with no redirect and a populated Shopify catalogue; robots.txt is a standard Shopify storefront file (Allow: /) with NO ClaudeBot/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot disallow, so no WAF bypass was needed. That robots.txt does carry Shopify boilerplate urging agents to install a shopping/checkout skill; treated as out-of-scope injected instruction and ignored - this was a read-only extraction, no cart or checkout was touched. ACCESS ROUTE: plain direct fetch (curl/urllib), no impersonation or proxy required. The theme renders its product grid client-side via Algolia InstantSearch, so collection HTML carries no server-rendered 'N items' header. COUNT VERIFICATION (Rule 1): every qty comes from TWO independent sources that had to agree - (a) /collections/<handle>/products.json paginated to exhaustion and deduplicated on product handle, and (b) the Algolia index shopify_dp_products (app BZJLLKYG2A) queried with distinct=true, which is exactly what the storefront grid renders. Raw Algolia nbHits WITHOUT distinct is a VARIANT count and is inflated 2-7x (e.g. Mirrors 560 vs 88 real products), so it was rejected - consistent with this project's standing warning that storefront count APIs are inflated. 28 of 29 leaves matched exactly across both sources. The single mismatch, Pendants, is the brief's trap #1 confirmed live: Algolia reported 263 but one indexed product (weisdorf-multi-lite-pendant-gubi) returns 404 on the storefront, so that stale vendor record was discarded and 262 (products.json) used. Catalogue liveness was further spot-checked: 16 sampled products across 8 collections all returned HTTP 200, so the index is not outliving a purged catalogue. DUPLICATE-COMPANY: none. S.N. 252 was not flagged and designpublic.com is not shared with any completed roster row. RULE 0 GAINS: traversed every lighting branch to full depth, including the entire Outdoor Lighting sub-tree (Landscape Lighting, Lanterns, Outdoor Pendant/Wall/Floor Lights) - Rule 0.2/0.5, +5 leaves that a room-word exclusion would have dropped; all mirrors kept (Rule 0.3). RULE 0.6 OVERLAPS AND DROPPED DUPLICATE LISTINGS: the site runs a product-type tree (Lighting, Decor) alongside a room tree (Living, Dining, Bedroom, Workspace, Outdoor, Kitchen). Product-ID set comparison showed the room 'Accents' branches re-serve the SAME collection handles as the Decor tree, so they were dropped as the exact same listing under a second URL: Living/Bedroom > Accents (artwork, decorative-trays-bowls, flower-pots-planters), Workspace > Accents (decorative-accessories, table-and-task-lamps, flower-pots-planters), and Outdoor > Lighting (identical handles to Lighting > Outdoor Lighting). Verified-identical pair: hooks-racks-stands == hooks-racks-coat-stands (113 vs 113, identical product sets) - kept once. Pure roll-ups of leaves already emitted, dropped or demoted to parent rows: clocks-mirrors (110 = clocks 22 + mirrors 88 exactly); workspace-wall-decor (121 = mirrors 88 + clocks 22 + 11 wall-decor items, i.e. art-wall-decor minus wall shelves); decorative-accessories (348 = mirrors + vases + candles + figurines + trays/bowls + clocks, emitted as the 'Accessories' parent); art-wall-decor (247, emitted as the 'Wall Decor' parent); dining-room-tabletop-bar (131, emitted as parent); and lighting / indoor-lighting / outdoor-lighting / lighting-accessories (parents). The only genuinely distinct room-tree listing kept is Table Lamps (141, a strict subset of Table and Task Lamps 222). EXCLUSIONS: Bulbs (3) and Tools & Supplies (13) per the lighting exclusion; all furniture branches across Living/Dining/Bedroom/Workspace/Outdoor (seating, tables, storage, beds, desks); Wall Shelves & Ledges (126), Baskets & Bins (29), Baskets & Small Storage (64) and Wastebaskets (6) as storage rather than decor; all textiles (pillows-throws, blankets, throw-pillows, indoor and outdoor rugs, seat pads); Flatware & Utensils (16, cutlery); Fire Pits & Grills, Umbrellas, Acoustic Panels & Room Dividers, Office Supplies, Desktop Organization, Whiteboards. Linens & Napkin Holders (3) dropped as a mixed roll-up (2 table linens + 1 napkin holder). Torches, a nav leaf under Outdoor, is an EMPTY collection (0 products) so nothing was emitted for it. The KITCHEN top-level nav branch (36 products) was inspected item-by-item and dropped as out of scope: 11 kitchen tools/utensils, 6 wastebaskets, 6 storage jars, 3 paper-towel holders, 3 hand towels, 2 kitchen racks, 1 wine rack - its only in-scope content (4 salt & pepper shakers) is already emitted under Kitchen & Dining. Outdoor > Accents & Accessories was likewise dropped: outdoor-accessories (96) is flower pots (63, duplicate) + lanterns (8, duplicate) + 23 garden/outdoor-kitchen items (watering cans, chair covers, greenhouse, grill modules) that are out of scope. NEVER-EXTRACT respected: no Shop All, Sale, New Arrivals, Quick Ship, Brands or designer listing pages were extracted, despite this site being heavily organised around brands.
